name: docs
description: Make and revise a living doc in the Docs format as a local folder: doc/doc.json names the doc, its tabs and its dropdown lists, and each tab is a tree of blocks (headings, paragraphs, lists and checklists, tables, code, quotes, pictures) whose characters carry ids, with chips for dates, @-mentions, links to tabs and dropdowns. This skill's script creates the doc (from markdown or a skeleton), imports a Markdown, Word (.docx) or PDF file as a new doc or a new tab, reads it, edits it in place block by block or as suggestions the person accepts or rejects, and exports it as Markdown, Word, PDF or HTML; a local page shows it where people type, comment, react and look back through each tab's versions, shared on the local network by link when asked. Use when someone asks for a document, report, plan, proposal, brief, memo, spec, handbook, guide or meeting notes to keep, share, comment on or revise together (even one they will send as Word or PDF), names the Docs type, or wants to change a folder that holds doc/doc.json. Not for a static HTML page, changing a Word file (.docx) they already have as Word, a slide deck, or an answer read once in chat.
